title: The Significant change in the village
subtitle: 数据统计 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 数据统计（科学与技术·数据与统计）
meta: 主题语境：数据统计（科学与技术·数据与统计）　|　核心词汇：significant　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 significant 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1979 the athlete wrote of ① a significant change in the village in the programme, and everybody in the stadium said at once that it was ② more significant than the one named there the year before. Three years on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the athlete, who never explained anything, had done it at once and gone home; it was the significant ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most significant change in the village anybody in the stadium had ever seen, or so the programme for September 1973 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too significant to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the trainer who had come to help; the significant ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the bib at the far track, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a significant part of the plan, and said that no trainer in his right mind would call it ⑥ as significant as the part of the plan they had once had in the old stadium. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was significant or not, and he said so.

By 1986 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the programme. What the line asked for was ⑦ something significant, and nothing besides. The trainer from the next stadium called the whole plan ⑧ quite significant; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the programme kept the names of the significant ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1989, in the rain, she wrote of another significant change in the village in the same programme, and the work, which took two years, seemed ⑨ more significant than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most significant part of the plan in the whole stadium, she said in 1991, was the one she could never quite name; the significant ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 重要（前置定语 a significant change in the village：1979 年运动员在秩序册里记下的那件重要的显著变化）
B. adj. 重要／显著（比较级 more significant than：文中两处，一处比村子的显著变化，一处比预想）
C. adj. 重要／显著（最高级 the most significant：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 重要（表语 too significant to do：母亲觉得它太重要，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 显著（前置定语 a significant part of the plan：叔叔把整件事称作一桩显著的一环）
F. adj. 显著（同级比较 as significant as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩方案中重要的一环相比）
G. adj. 显著（后置定语 something significant：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 显著（受程度副词修饰 quite significant：那位陪练的评价）

items.q: a significant change in the village
the most significant change in the village anybody
a significant part of the plan
The most significant part of the plan in

answers.why: significant 意为“重要”，1979 年运动员在秩序册里记下的是“一件重要的显著变化”，此处作前置定语 a significant change in the village。
significant 意为“重要”，此处用比较级 more significant than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
significant 意为“重要”，秩序册上 九月 那行字说它是体育场里最重要的一件，故用最高级 the most significant change in the village。
significant 意为“重要”，母亲认为这件东西“太重要了，谁也用不上”，too significant to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
significant 意为“显著”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩显著的一环”，此处作前置定语 a significant part of the plan。
significant 意为“显著”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩方案中重要的一环一样显著”，同级比较用 as significant as。
significant 意为“显著”，秩序册上那半行字要的是“显著的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something significant。
significant 意为“显著”，邻体育场来的那位陪练认为这套计划“相当显著”，quite 修饰原级 significant。
significant 意为“显著”，1989 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要显著”，故用比较级 more significant than。
significant 意为“显著”，母亲 1991 年说的是“整个体育场里最显著的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most significant part of the plan。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1979 年，运动员在秩序册里记下了一件重要的显著变化。（a significant change in the village）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更重要。（more significant than …）
母亲觉得它太重要，谁也用不上。（too significant to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩显著的一环。（a significant part of the plan）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩方案中重要的一环一样显著。（as significant as …）
到了 1986 年，秩序册上只剩半行字：要的是一件显著的东西。（something significant）
answers: In 1979 the athlete wrote of a significant change in the village in the programme.
Everybody said it was more significant than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too significant to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a significant part of the plan.
He said nobody would call it as significant as the part of the plan they had once had.
By 1986 the programme asked for nothing but something significant.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 significant 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1979 the athlete wrote of a significant change in the village in the programme, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most significant change in the village in the stadium, or so the programme says.
My mother thought it too significant to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a significant part of the plan, and nobody argued with him.
The trainer from the next stadium called the plan quite significant, and everybody laughed.
The significant ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
